## Step 4 - live validation (read-only safe gate)

- `CVE-2021-43798` -> **CONFIRMED** (matched_at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/public/plugins/alertlist/../../../../../../../../../../../../../../../../../../etc/passwd`)

**Reading it:** a tag rule gathers every grafana CVE but cannot tell which applies to 8.3.0; the version parser trips on inconsistent/missing ranges; the LLM reads the prose and picks the applicable one, then the SAME engine runs that real community template live and code assigns the verdict. Intrusive CVEs are refused by the read-only gate. One product / version: a demonstration, not a breadth guarantee.
